ItemName.description: The text description for the invoice line item

Quantity.description: The quantity for this invoice line item

POMatch.description: Please classify the line item based on match with the PO

enumDescriptions.OnlyInPO: Line item only present in the PO but not in the invoice
enumDescriptions.Match: Line item matched to PO exactly
enumDescriptions.PartialMatch: Line item partially matched to PO, provide details in MatchingInconsistency field

MatchingInconsistency.description: Please provide explanations of the inconsistencies if POMatch is PartialMatch

LineItems.description: Invoice line item. It should be extracted either from invoice or PO.

Evidence.description: Evidence or reasoning for the inconsistency in the invoice.

InvoiceField.description: Invoice field or the aspect that is inconsistent with the contract.

PaymentTermsInconsistencies.description: List all areas of inconsistency identified in the invoice with corresponding evidence.

InvoicePONumber.description: Purchase Order (PO) number as per the invoice document. If more than one PO is present, generate a list of strings.

OrderPONumber.description: Purchase Order (PO) number as per the purchase order document. If more than one PO is present, generate a list of strings.
